meta.engine: Transitous (api.transitous.org), public OpenTripPlanner-compatible router fed by MTA NYC Transit GTFS + OSM. Queried one origin/destination pair at a time because the /one-to-all endpoint returned Failed on every attempt.
meta.method: Origin = geocoded hotel (Nominatim, house number only). Destination = geocoded restaurant address. Departure = 'now' on 2026-11-25 (a Wednesday) — a weekday, midday. Times are door-to-door including walking.
meta.caveat: Measured at one weekday midday departure. Night and weekend service differs (the B, M, W, Z and some bus routes are weekday-only or reduced). Add 5–10 min of buffer for late dinners, which is when the starred restaurants are booked.
meta.why_not_a_full_matrix: The one-to-all travel-time endpoint failed against this API, so a 10-hotel x 69-restaurant isochrone matrix could not be produced. What follows is the measured sample plus a geometric 'walkable to' screen, clearly labelled as derived.

measured_legs.mode: Bus (M12) — W 14 St/9 Av to W 58 St/Broadway
C train, 50 St to Fulton St

hotel_cluster_screen.method: Straight-line distance from the hotel's geocoded point to each starred restaurant's geocoded point, converted to minutes of walking at a flat 4.8 km/h and NOT used as a travel time. It is only a screen for 'this is plausibly a walk' versus 'this needs the subway', so the page can say which cluster each hotel plausibly serves without inventing a transit time.
hotel_cluster_screen.caveat: Straight-line walking distance ignores the river, park edges and the street grid's one-way quirks, so it under-estimates Manhattan distances by roughly 20–30%. Count a badge here as 'plausible', not as 'verified'.

fare_note: MTA subway and local bus fare is a flat $2.90 per ride (OMNY or MetroCard); a 7-day unlimited MetroCard costs $34. The fare was not re-verified from mta.info in this pass — treat the numbers as indicative until checked.
practical: February 2027 NYC weather means most of these rides will feel longer than the router says — platform waits are outdoors on the bus routes that serve several of these legs.
Every measured leg above used zero or one transfer. The grid is forgiving: almost everything on this list is one seat away from almost everything else.
CIVILIAN at 305 W 48th St and MADE at 44 W 29th are the two hotels that put multiple 3★ rooms inside a 15-minute walk.
For late tasting-menu seatings (21:00+), check the subway line's weekend/weeknight status before committing — the C and E both drop frequency after 22:00.
